author: swivr
body:
This category is dedicated to users whom have created maps for The Avicus Network. In order to keep the category clean and organized, please adhere to the following guidelines and rules, if they are not followed the discussion is subject to staff modifications or deletion.

Discussion Requirements:
  • Map Download (Mediafire or Dropbox is recommended)
  • Images of the map
    • Complete overview
    • Album of images displaying more details (imgur.com)
  • Title is formatted correctly
  • Map Banner & Map Thumbnail
  • Body containing further details about the map that you would like to share
  • XML if you already have it/know how to make it (You may contact a map developer to make one or a community member)
Title:
  • Must have the game-mode name in brackets
    • [Avicade]
    • [DTM]
    • [TDM]
    • [KoTH]
    • [CTF]
    • [CTW]
    • [Frenzy]
    • [Skywars]
  • Must have your map's unique name. (Example: Quintus [DTM] or [DTM] Quintus)
  • Version must be included after the map's name
Map:
  • Built in void map
  • Must be original
  • Pruned
XML:
  • Uses localization
  • Tutorial
  • Propper formatting
  • Comments whenever necessary


In order for a map to be accepted, it must have a completed .xml file. This file is used by our plugins to determine where players spawn, what items they will have, and where objectives will be placed. After the map is accepted, the player gives the Avicus Network the rights to edit the map as they see fit. To learn more, visit
